messages.author: 980895422e39156a
messages.subject: Error in Multivariate regression
parts:
Hi Folks,

I am new for the STAN.
When I made a code, I got error message.
It looks simple but I do not know how to deal with it.
Could you give any suggestion?
My code and error message are below..

# Part of Code

   xx[p] ~ multi_normal((Va1[p]*Lo_beta[1] + Va2[p]*Lo_beta[2] + Va3[p]*Lo_beta[3] + Va4[p]*Lo_beta[4] + Va5[p]*Lo_beta[5] + Va6[p]*Lo_beta[6]), Lo_Cw);
   kk[p] ~ multi_normal((Va1[p]*Sh_beta[1] + Va2[p]*Sh_beta[2] + Va3[p]*Sh_beta[3] + Va4[p]*Sh_beta[4] + Va5[p]*Sh_beta[5] + Va6[p]*Sh_beta[6]), Sh_Cw);


# Error Message


No matches for: 

  row vector ~ multi_normal(real, matrix)

Available argument signatures for multi_normal:

  vector ~ multi_normal(vector, matrix)
  vector ~ multi_normal(row vector, matrix)


Thank you for your help in advance.

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Error in Multivariate regression
parts:
Hi Kuk-Hyun,

It's hard to debug without the full code, but your error message is telling you that the types are incorrect. It's also not clear which line is throwing the error message, but if it's the first, this message:

No matches for:

  row vector ~ multi_normal(real, matrix)

is telling you that:
-  xx[p] is a row_vector
- (Va1[p]*Lo_beta[1] + Va2[p]*Lo_beta[2] + Va3[p]*Lo_beta[3] + Va4[p]*Lo_beta[4] + Va5[p]*Lo_beta[5] + Va6[p]*Lo_beta[6]) is a real
- Lo_Cw is a matrix

You'll need to transpose xx[p] to be a vector and I'm not sure what your intent is with the first argument to multi_normal(); it should take a vector or row_vector, not a scalar (single real value).



Daniel

It's hard to debug without the full code, but your error message is telling you that the types are incorrect. It's also not clear which line is throwing the error message, but if it's the first, this message:

No matches for:

  row vector ~ multi_normal(real, matrix)

is telling you that:
-  xx[p] is a row_vector
- (Va1[p]*Lo_beta[1] + Va2[p]*Lo_beta[2] + Va3[p]*Lo_beta[3] + Va4[p]*Lo_beta[4] + Va5[p]*Lo_beta[5] + Va6[p]*Lo_beta[6]) is a real
- Lo_Cw is a matrix

You'll need to transpose xx[p] to be a vector and I'm not sure what your intent is with the first argument to multi_normal(); it should take a vector or row_vector, not a scalar (single real value).



Daniel
